sn22.1:0.1: suttantapiṭake saṃyuttanikāyassa tatiyo bhāgo khandhavāravaggo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. khandhasaṃyuttaṃ mūlapaṇṇāsake nakulapitavaggo paṭhamo
sn22.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye …pe…
sn22.1:1.3: atha kho nakulapitā gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nakulapitā gahapata bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.1:2.1: ahamasmi bhante jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇātaṅko
sn22.1:2.2: aniccadassāvī kho panāhaṃ bhante bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañca bhikkhūnaṃ
sn22.1:2.5: yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn22.1:3.2: āturo hāyaṃ gahapati kāyo aṇḍabhūto pariyonaddho
sn22.1:3.3: yo hi gahapati imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttaṃpi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya kimaññatra bālyā
sn22.1:3.4: tasmā tiha te gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
sn22.1:3.5: āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatīti
sn22.1:4.1: atha kho nakulapitā gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā sārīputto etadavoca
sn22.1:4.4: alattha no ajja bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
sn22.1:5.2: idānāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisittoti.
sn22.1:5.3: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ gahapati bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisittoti.
sn22.1:5.4: idhāhaṃ bhante yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. ekamantaṃ nisinno khohaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ etadavocaṃ
sn22.1:5.5: ahamasmi bhante jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇātaṅko
sn22.1:5.6: aniccadassāvī kho panāhaṃ bhante bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañca bhikkhūnaṃ
sn22.1:5.9: yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn22.1:6.1: evaṃ vutte maṃ bhante bhagavā etadavoca
sn22.1:6.3: āturo hāyaṃ gahapati kāyo aṇḍabhūto pariyonaddho
sn22.1:6.4: yo hi gahapati imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttaṃpi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya kimaññatra bālyā
sn22.1:6.5: tasmā tiha te gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
sn22.1:6.6: āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatīti
sn22.1:6.8: evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisittoti.
sn22.1:7.1: na hi pana tvaṃ gahapati paṭibhāsi bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ paṭipucchituṃ
sn22.1:7.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante āturakāyo ceva hoti āturacitto ca kittāvatā ca pana āturakāyopi kho hoti no ca āturacittoti.
sn22.1:7.3: dūratopi kho mayaṃ bhante āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sārīputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ
sn22.1:7.4: sādhu vatāyasmantaṃ yeva sārīputtaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa atthoti.
sn22.1:8.1: tenahi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
sn22.1:8.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho nakulapitā gahapati āyasmato sārīputtassa paccassosi.
sn22.1:9.1: kathañca gahapati āturakāyo ceva hoti āturacitto ca.
sn22.1:9.2: idha gahapati assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.1:9.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:9.4: ahaṃ rūpaṃ mama rūpanti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:9.5: tassa ahaṃ rūpaṃ mama rūpanti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:10.1: vedanaṃ attato samanupassati vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā vedanaṃ vedanāya vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:10.2: ahaṃ vedanā mama vedanāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:10.3: tassa ahaṃ vedanā mama vedanāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā vedanā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:11.1: saññaṃ attato samanupassati saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā saññaṃ saññāya vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:11.2: ahaṃ saññā mama saññāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:11.3: tassa ahaṃ saññā mama saññāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā saññā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:12.1: saṅkhāre attato samanupassati saṅkhāravantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā saṅkhāre saṅkhāresu vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:12.2: ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:12.3: tassa ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino te saṅkhārā vipariṇamanti aññathā hoti
sn22.1:13.1: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:13.2: ahaṃ viññāṇaṃ mama viññāṇanti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:13.3: tassa ahaṃ viññāṇaṃ mama viññāṇanti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:13.5: evaṃ kho gahapati āturakāyo ceva hoti āturacitto ca.
sn22.1:14.1: kathañca gahapati āturakāyopi kho hoti no ca āturacitto.
sn22.1:14.2: idha gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.1:14.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:14.4: ahaṃ rūpaṃ mama rūpanti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:14.5: tassa ahaṃ rūpaṃ mama rūpanti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:15.1: na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati na vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā vedanaṃ na vedanāya vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:15.2: ahaṃ vedanā mama vedanāti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:15.3: tassa ahaṃ vedanā mama vedanāti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā vedanā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:16.1: na saññaṃ attato samanupassati na saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā saññaṃ na saññāya vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:16.2: ahaṃ saññā mama saññāti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:16.3: tassa ahaṃ saññā mama saññāti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā saññā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:17.1: na saṅkhāre attato samanupassati na saṅkhāravantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā saṅkhāre na saṅkhāresu vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:17.2: ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārāti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:17.3: tassa ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārāti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino te saṅkhārā vipariṇamanti aññathā honti
sn22.1:18.1: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:18.2: ahaṃ viññāṇaṃ mama viññāṇanti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
sn22.1:18.3: tassa ahaṃ viññāṇaṃ mama viññāṇanti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti
sn22.1:18.5: evaṃ kho gahapati āturakāyopi kho hoti no ca āturacittoti.
sn22.1:19.2: attamano nakulapitā gahapati āyasmato sārīputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
